name: Alert Endknob
description: Draw the slung ram back along its chains with a steady pull, feeding qi to the tired hands.

name: Swift Beamdrive
description: Release the held ram so it swings straight along its line into the centre of the door.

name: Ramzip
description: Slip out of the ram's line as it returns, keeping one hand on the chain.

name: Alert Ramcap
description: Feel the chain through the palm to know the ram's weight and the moment it comes to rest.

name: Raw Shudder
description: Time a pulse of qi to the swing's low point so the blow lands harder and jars the bar from its cradle.

name: Headcap Carapace
description: Catch the rebounding ram on its chains and step with its motion, shedding force that would throw the crew.

name: Genial Wheelbase
description: Line the crew along the haul ropes and match each bearer's pull so the ram rises level.

name: Sturdy Carryhandle
description: Loop the rope end round the forearm and brace the legs to hold the ram's weight at the top of its arc.

name: Rushing Beamdrive
description: Keep both feet flat and drive the ram forward from the hips so the blow lands square.

name: Boughswerve
description: Drop behind the frame post as the door bursts, leaving flying timber to pass overhead.

name: Fleet Hammerin
description: Step back two paces with the ram's rebound and set the feet for a second blow.

name: Alert Slingchain
description: Call a rhythm in short syllables so every bearer drives on the same breath.

name: Logscorer
description: Lock arms with the neighbouring bearer and drive together, so the blow carries the crew's joined weight.

name: Attentive Wheelbase
description: Pour qi into the return haul so the ram climbs to its next swing faster and the crew regains its footing.

name: Kindly Endknob
description: Count the heartbeats the ram takes to swing from rest to rest and use the count to time the next release.

name: Rough Shudder
description: Strike the door at the ram's lowest point, where the swing carries its greatest speed.

name: Beamslap
description: Let the ram swing only half its arc to test the door's give before committing the full weight.

name: Beamhead Buckle
description: Tense the legs a breath before the rebound so the ram's return does not stagger the crew.

name: Veering Hammerin
description: Hold the release a moment longer while stepping in, so the ram arrives as the foe lowers his guard.

name: Ramcapflog
description: Tap the door at the beam's natural beat so the wood shivers and the bar rattles loose from its brackets.

name: Doughty Pounddown
description: Let a pulse of qi ride the rebound so the return swing strikes a defender who steps forward after the first blow.

name: Brawn Ramcap
description: Give the lead bearer's order that sets every grip at the same height before the lift.

name: Loghurdle
description: Advance in a staggered file so each bearer's feet find ground cleared by the one ahead.

name: Braced Ramtail
description: Settle the beam in the crooks of the elbows so shared weight rests on the bones and not the arms.

name: Ember Ramhorn
description: Run the last five paces together and release the beam's forward momentum into the door on one shout.

name: Cooling Headcap
description: The corner bearer scans windows and rooftops above, calling any shooter or dropped stone before it falls.

name: Dense Bandring
description: Catch a slipping beam end on a knee and both forearms, rolling it clear of the ankle.

name: Logglide
description: Slide a fresh bearer into a tired one's place mid-stride without slowing the beam.

name: Momentbeam
description: Fan the crew into a wedge behind the beam and push as one, so pressure from the door's inside cannot push back.

name: Sprout Carryhandle
description: Draw a joint breath and let linked qi flow through the beam, heaving it forward with the crew's whole strength.

name: Draught Pounddown
description: Roll a shoulder along the shattered door's edge and enter beneath the swinging leaf, striking the first defender.

name: Lithe Beamdrive
description: Push the roofed frame forward on its wheels with shoulders against the rear posts, a thread of qi steadying each shove.

name: Resolute Ramhorn
description: Crouch beneath the frame's hide-covered roof so arrows and thrown stones strike the covering and fall away.

name: Hearty Bandring
description: Run fingers along roof pegs and hide ties to feel for any heat or loosened lashing.

name: Dawn Endknob
description: Count the draw aloud in the frame's shade so every bearer keeps one pace despite the din outside.

name: Staticlog
description: Release the hanging ram from beneath the roof so its blow lands while the crew stays covered.

name: Stalwart Beamhead
description: Fling water over the roof hides to smother thrown fire before the lashings scorch.

name: Ramcap Buckle
description: Press qi up through the ridge beam, stiffening the roof so dropped stones glance off and the crew pushes on.

name: Claybough
description: Swing the ram on short chains in the frame's tight space, hitting hard enough to jar the barricade's props.

name: Gritbough
description: Push the roofed frame through the smoke of a lit barricade, wet hides and held breath carrying the crew past.

name: Swayswing Flog
description: Drive the hand ram's cap onto the hinge pin's head until the pin walks loose.

name: Shielding Wheelbase
description: Hold the short ram across the chest in narrow passages so a foe can neither seize it nor pass it.

name: Gagging Swayswing
description: Hook the ram's neck behind the door's stile and lever outward, wrenching a bolt from its seat.

name: Pirouetting Smitedown
description: Advance up a narrow stair with the ram held upright, using the side wall to guide each step.

name: Bold Hammerin
description: Drive the cap down on the upper hinge then the lower in two quick blows, so the door sags from its frame.

name: Logprop
description: Pry the door's edge outward with the haft, then slam the cap into the gap before defenders can force it shut.

name: Poise Ramhorn
description: Settle the beam's weight on the hips with the arms light, so qi can travel down to the legs.

name: Clay Swayswing
description: Walk over uneven ground by feeling its swell with the soles, never lifting the heels high.

name: Purpose Ramtail
description: Pass a rope sling under the beam and lift with the crew's legs, qi easing the first inch.

name: Brawnbeam
description: Turn the carried beam at a corner by pivoting on the inner foot while the outer bearers swing wide.

name: Brassramcap
description: Let the beam's front slide forward from the shoulders and shove it into a foe or door at the carry's end.

name: Sprig Slingchain
description: Hold the beam across the front of the crew as a rail while shafts and stones strike its far side.

name: Coasting Shudder
description: Roll the carry's weight from one bearer to the next so a lunging foe finds only a moving beam.

name: Shudder Swat
description: Sustain a qi-fuelled charge with the beam on the shoulders, driving the line forward until the target gives.

name: Headcap Poultice
description: Judge the bar's height from the door's rattle and the shadow of its slot, then aim the cap at it.

name: Ramscorer
description: Aim the cap at the midpoint of the bar's span so the timber bends and cracks.

name: Claylog
description: Lean the ram into the door as one steady press, forcing the bar to bow in its brackets.

name: Padded Slingchain
description: Brace the feet on stone when defenders shove from inside and hold the ram where it is.

name: Beamcurl
description: Slide the feet sideways to bring the cap square to a bracket after the first blow has glanced.

name: Emberramcap
description: Continue the drive through the splintering bar so the broken ends spin aside and the door swings open.

name: Lurching Pounddown
description: Alternate blows high and low against a door with two bars, giving defenders no time to re-brace either.
